source.title: The real answer: how professional betting operations created edge

statusDefinitions.implemented_local: Implemented in local source with a retained code or test artifact.
statusDefinitions.partial_local: A concrete local foundation exists, but one or more required operational behaviors remain incomplete.
statusDefinitions.blocked_external: Completion depends on licensed data, credentials, settled production history, capital, or human operations that this repository cannot manufacture.
statusDefinitions.prohibited_by_design: The source explicitly rejects this tactic and Bear Edge records it as a forbidden behavior rather than an implementation target.

requirements.requirement: Treat durable betting advantage as an industrial process combining probability quality, price quality, information speed, specialization, selectivity, execution, recordkeeping, and patient capital rather than as a single prediction formula.

evidence.claim: The approved architecture covers decision integrity, local records, calibration, execution evidence, and external gates.

requirements.requirement: Combine independent model information with information contained in sportsbook prices instead of treating either source as complete by itself.

evidence.claim: The priced-candidate path combines model probability with de-vigged market intelligence.

requirements.requirement: Build and maintain a sufficiently large historical database for the specialized market before claiming predictive superiority.
requirements.blocker: A licensed historical odds and outcomes corpus with sufficient settled volume has not been supplied to this checkout.

evidence.claim: Production readiness identifies provider and settled-history evidence as external gates.

requirements.requirement: Clean, normalize, validate, and preserve source identity before information enters model training or decision logic.

evidence.claim: Calibration dataset validation rejects malformed, duplicated, and time-inconsistent observations.

requirements.requirement: Produce probabilities rather than only categorical winner or loser labels.

evidence.claim: The research estimator emits count-market probabilities.

requirements.requirement: Size exposure according to the magnitude and reliability of the model-market discrepancy, subject to conservative stake caps.

evidence.claim: Expected value, Kelly fraction, Kelly multipliers, and bankroll caps determine recommended stake.

requirements.requirement: Update evaluation and model evidence from actual settled results rather than from anecdotes or unrecorded outcomes.

evidence.claim: Settlements and amendments are reconstructed from immutable records for performance analysis.

requirements.requirement: Derive actionable probability from independent projection, market consensus, calibration evidence, and an uncertainty discount.

evidence.claim: The evaluation path applies market weighting, model registry evidence, conservative adjustments, and uncertainty-sensitive gates.

requirements.requirement: Construct an independent fair price for a narrowly defined market before comparing it with tradable sportsbook offers.

evidence.claim: Research candidates include a model probability and fair American odds before provider pricing is attached.

requirements.requirement: Translate model forecasts and sportsbook prices into comparable probability quantities before measuring disagreement.

evidence.claim: American prices are converted to implied and two-way no-vig probabilities.

requirements.requirement: Review whether a material disagreement reflects information, noise, stale data, high hold, or market inconsistency before acting.

evidence.claim: Market intelligence emits hold, freshness, dispersion, movement, and sharp-confirmation evidence and risk flags.

requirements.requirement: Collect equivalent offers from multiple sportsbooks rather than evaluating a single default book in isolation.

evidence.claim: The price-selection test proves best-price selection across multiple returned books.

requirements.requirement: Remove two-way market vig before treating sportsbook prices as fair-probability evidence.

evidence.claim: normalizeTwoWayMarket divides each implied probability by total implied probability.

requirements.requirement: Weight sportsbooks according to demonstrated historical information quality, with transparent and versioned weighting evidence.

evidence.claim: The current engine supports sharp-book and explicit weights, but does not yet learn weights from a production movement history.

requirements.requirement: Calculate a timestamp-filtered weighted consensus probability for each exactly matched market.

evidence.claim: Fresh unique bookmaker entries feed a weighted consensus probability.

requirements.requirement: Identify offers that are materially out of alignment with the informed market consensus.

evidence.claim: Consensus dispersion, offered price, and reference probability are retained for discrepancy evaluation.

requirements.requirement: Exclude stale, future-dated, suspended, unavailable, and mismatched market observations from consensus and decision authority.

evidence.claim: Stale and invalid timestamps are excluded; provider suspension semantics still depend on the external adapter payload.

requirements.requirement: Recommend only when the offered price clears a registered minimum advantage over the consensus and adjusted model probabilities.

evidence.claim: Fair-edge, price-edge, expected-value, and minimum-price gates can each reject an offer.

requirements.requirement: Measure whether selected outlier prices later converge toward the broader market and closing number.

evidence.claim: Calibration reports require final closing prices and calculate closing-line value with uncertainty intervals.

requirements.requirement: Compare the system fair line with the live bookmaker line and increase consideration only when the verified discrepancy grows.

evidence.claim: Candidate rank and verdict use fair edge, price edge, expected value, and risk evidence.

requirements.requirement: Every actionable recommendation must state the exact offered American price used in its calculation.

evidence.claim: Priced ticket selections include the exact sportsbook price.

requirements.requirement: Every actionable recommendation must identify the sportsbook offering the evaluated price and support an exact required-book constraint.

evidence.claim: A focused test proves exact required-sportsbook selection.

requirements.requirement: Calculate and publish the worst acceptable price that still satisfies price edge, expected value, Kelly, minimum stake, and stake-cap constraints.

evidence.claim: calculateMinimumAcceptablePrice solves strict economic and stake boundaries and fails closed when infeasible.

requirements.requirement: Attach a time-dependent validity boundary to every priced recommendation so the user can see how quickly the captured edge expires.

evidence.claim: Price discipline calculates validUntil from freshness and event-cutoff boundaries.

requirements.requirement: Detect whether the market moved toward or against the selected side after the first observed price.

evidence.claim: Line-movement history produces STEAM_WITH or STEAM_AGAINST evidence.

requirements.requirement: Treat an offered price as actionable only while the provider reports it with a valid fresh timestamp and exact market match.

evidence.claim: The engine verifies provider capture and freshness at evaluation time, but cannot guarantee the book screen remains unchanged after delivery.

requirements.requirement: Calculate a conservative stake from adjusted probability, odds, expected value, Kelly fraction, bankroll, and hard caps.

evidence.claim: Core decision tests cover Kelly staking and cap enforcement.

requirements.requirement: Represent uncertainty explicitly and use it to discount or block recommendations rather than presenting a point estimate as certainty.

evidence.claim: Each MLB count candidate carries an observed-count probability interval, and the lower bound controls decision probability with independently checked reference values.

requirements.requirement: Reject a new recommendation when open positions would create excessive correlated exposure.

evidence.claim: Portfolio tests reject duplicate and event-correlated exposure over configured caps.

requirements.requirement: Keep execution transparent, legal, contract-compatible, and suitable for customer and acquisition diligence.

evidence.claim: The approved non-goals reject automatic wagering, access-control bypass, and unverified odds; legal review remains external.

requirements.requirement: Treat the line and price as the product and never emit a naked player or team selection as an actionable bet.

evidence.claim: Unpriced targets are forced to WAIT with PRICE_CHECK_ONLY permission.

requirements.requirement: Retain fair probability, market probability, adjusted probability, and edge quantities with the exact price decision.

evidence.claim: Immutable evaluation records preserve probability, price, fair edge, price edge, expected value, and Kelly fields.

requirements.requirement: Launch with one narrow, provable market family before expanding to additional sports or prop families.

evidence.claim: Models are scoped by market family, but the research candidate surface still contains more than one sport and market family.

requirements.requirement: Use specialization to obtain cleaner data, stable feature definitions, meaningful samples, and faster diagnostics.

evidence.claim: Calibration and promotion are market-family specific, but sufficient production sample evidence is not yet available.

requirements.requirement: Choose a launch market only when reliable live odds are legally available.
requirements.blocker: Reliable live odds require a configured licensed provider and current account entitlements.

evidence.claim: Provider requirements classify verified odds as an external configuration dependency.

requirements.requirement: Choose a launch market only when reliable historical opening, movement, and closing lines are available.
requirements.blocker: No complete licensed historical line archive is present in the repository.

evidence.claim: Historical and closing-line evidence remains a data acquisition gate.

requirements.requirement: Choose a player market only when lineups, injuries, roles, and availability can be verified with legally usable data.
requirements.blocker: Licensed, timely lineup and injury verification is not configured for all supported events.

evidence.claim: Lineup, injury, and roster providers are explicit setup requirements.

requirements.requirement: Choose a launch market only when final closing prices can be captured for evaluation.
requirements.blocker: The code validates closing prices, but a continuous external closing-price feed and settled production history are not available.

evidence.claim: The dataset contract validates final closing price and market-close timestamps when supplied.
Authoritative settlements become settled calibration rows only when exact-book final closing evidence and retained source provenance are complete.
Projection tests prove missing closing provenance remains unresolved and valid amendments control the effective closing line.

requirements.requirement: Require enough events and settled observations to support calibration and promotion before expansion.
requirements.blocker: The registered minimum sample thresholds have not been met with real settled out-of-sample records.

evidence.claim: Promotion policy declares minimum settled observations and bucket counts.

requirements.requirement: Use only data whose license, terms, and acquisition method permit the intended commercial use.
requirements.blocker: Commercial licensing and legal sufficiency require provider contracts and counsel review outside this repository.

evidence.claim: Provider documentation separates configured APIs from sources that are not verified commercial feeds.

requirements.requirement: Treat the sportsbook market as a strong ensemble prior and require strong evidence before overruling it.

evidence.claim: Model probability is shrunk toward the no-vig market probability before edge is calculated.

requirements.requirement: Produce an independent sport-specific model probability before market blending.

evidence.claim: Candidate construction estimates model probability from sport-specific official context before odds matching.

requirements.requirement: Retain a de-vigged market probability separately from raw implied probability.

evidence.claim: Evaluation records preserve marketImpliedProbability and marketNoVigProbability separately.

requirements.requirement: Identify informative or sharp books and retain how their observations affect consensus confidence.

evidence.claim: Sharp-book flags and multipliers exist, but historical information-quality learning is not yet production-trained.

requirements.requirement: Use market-family-specific historical reliability and calibration evidence to govern model authority.

evidence.claim: Decision authority resolves immutable registry and calibration-report evidence for the candidate market family.

requirements.requirement: Shrink weak or uncertain forecasts toward market consensus and allow greater independence only after market-specific reliability is demonstrated.

evidence.claim: Market confidence adjusts blend weight and conservative market-specific penalties.

requirements.requirement: Calibrate probabilities with chronological out-of-sample evidence and block production authority until registered thresholds are satisfied.

evidence.claim: Calibration tests cover chronological evidence, metrics, uncertainty intervals, and promotion thresholds.

requirements.requirement: Re-evaluate affected markets after injury information changes and before relying on any previously captured edge.

evidence.claim: Injury change is an invalidation condition, but a licensed push feed is required for continuous automatic detection.

requirements.requirement: Re-evaluate affected markets when a lineup is released or changes.

evidence.claim: Lineup change is an explicit invalidation condition, but automated detection depends on an external verified lineup feed.

requirements.requirement: Re-evaluate weather-sensitive markets when material weather conditions change.
requirements.blocker: A verified event-linked weather provider is not configured for continuous decision invalidation.

evidence.claim: Weather context is an explicit provider requirement.

requirements.requirement: Detect and record when an informative market moves before slower books or derivative markets.

evidence.claim: Line movement and sharp-book participation are recorded; cross-market lead-lag learning needs historical provider data.

requirements.requirement: Every priced recommendation must expose an explicit expiration timestamp and the condition that controls it.

evidence.claim: The price-discipline test proves expiration at the earliest freshness or event-time boundary.

requirements.requirement: Invalidate the recommendation when the available price becomes worse than the calculated minimum acceptable price.

evidence.claim: A below_minimum status blocks the recommendation when current odds fail the price floor.

requirements.requirement: Invalidate the recommendation after a material lineup change.

evidence.claim: The invalidation vocabulary includes lineup_changed; live trigger wiring depends on a verified lineup stream.

requirements.requirement: Invalidate the recommendation after a material injury-status change.

evidence.claim: The invalidation vocabulary includes injury_status_changed; live trigger wiring depends on a verified injury stream.

requirements.requirement: Invalidate the recommendation when the offered market or its supporting consensus exceeds freshness limits.

evidence.claim: Stale offered and consensus timestamps create risk flags and cannot support an active BET.

requirements.requirement: Expire recommendations before the event enters a configured prohibited pre-start or live window.

evidence.claim: eventStartAt minus prohibitedWindowMinutes is an explicit validity boundary.

requirements.requirement: Invalidate a recommendation when required source data exceeds its registered freshness limit or loses verification.

evidence.claim: Provider freshness is measured, while recommendation-specific automatic invalidation across every upstream source is not fully wired.

requirements.requirement: Select the best fresh available number across returned sportsbooks rather than the first or preferred book by default.

evidence.claim: The focused test proves that the highest fresh American price is selected.

requirements.requirement: For spread and total markets, define the maximum acceptable line in addition to the minimum acceptable price.

evidence.claim: Line change is an invalidation condition, but a general maximum spread or total tolerance is not yet calculated for all market types.

requirements.requirement: Generate an operator or customer notification when an active edge disappears because price, line, or evidence changes.

evidence.claim: Automatic refresh snapshots exist, but durable per-recommendation disappearance notifications are not yet delivered.

requirements.requirement: Use deterministic PASS, WAIT, and BET outcomes and accept that most evaluated markets should not become bets.

evidence.claim: Canonical deterministic verdict logic emits only PASS, WAIT, or BET.

requirements.requirement: Issue PASS when registered fair-edge or price-edge thresholds are not cleared.

evidence.claim: Fair-edge and price-edge gates emit explicit reasons and risk flags.

requirements.requirement: Issue WAIT or PASS when predictive or market uncertainty exceeds registered limits.

evidence.claim: Observed predictive intervals and market dispersion have registered limits; missing or excessive uncertainty forces WAIT.

requirements.requirement: Issue WAIT when the offered price is stale, missing a timestamp, invalid, or future-dated.

evidence.claim: Timestamp status produces high-severity freshness risk flags.

requirements.requirement: Block full market authority when the opposite side needed to remove vig is absent.

evidence.claim: The core decision path requires two-way odds for no-vig evaluation.

requirements.requirement: Issue WAIT when relevant injury evidence is stale, unresolved, contradictory, or missing.

evidence.claim: The decision engine contains stale-injury gates, but complete coverage depends on a licensed injury provider.

requirements.requirement: Issue WAIT when a lineup-sensitive market lacks verified lineup confirmation.

evidence.claim: Lineup verification is tracked as a required external source rather than inferred from screenshots.

requirements.requirement: Prevent BET authority when market-family sample size or probability-bucket support is below registered minimums.

evidence.claim: Promotion policy registers minimum settled observations and bucket support.

requirements.requirement: Prevent a research-only or calibration-failing model from authorizing a BET verdict.

evidence.claim: API tests prove caller-forged calibration authority is rejected and research models remain WAIT.

requirements.requirement: Block or discount a recommendation after material adverse market movement.

evidence.claim: Adverse movement produces STEAM_AGAINST evidence considered by the risk path.

requirements.requirement: Block a recommendation when projected event, participant, market-family, or correlation exposure exceeds policy.

evidence.claim: Portfolio policy evaluates event, participant, market-family, and correlation caps.

requirements.requirement: Block verified betting authority when a required provider is missing, stale, degraded, or unverified.

evidence.claim: Provider status distinguishes okay, degraded, and blocked sources and preserves warnings.

requirements.requirement: Issue WAIT when material evidence sources disagree beyond registered tolerance.

evidence.claim: Excessive consensus dispersion creates a high-severity MARKET_DISAGREEMENT flag.

requirements.requirement: Review rather than blindly bet an outlier price when sharp confirmation, timestamp quality, or counterpart evidence is inadequate.

evidence.claim: The engine discounts unconfirmed longshots and flags unverified, stale, high-hold, or disputed market evidence.

requirements.requirement: Reject a recommendation when projected total stake for the risk date exceeds the configured bankroll fraction.

evidence.claim: A focused test proves rejection when projected daily exposure exceeds the cap.

requirements.requirement: Operate a continuous feedback loop because fixed market inefficiencies and fixed algorithms decay.

evidence.claim: Repeatable calibration reports exist, but scheduled model retraining and promotion remain operator-controlled.
The operator can deterministically project the authoritative ledger, audit every exclusion and blocker, and emit report-ready JSON Lines without automatic promotion.

requirements.requirement: Measure closing-line value for settled predictions and retain uncertainty around the mean value.

evidence.claim: Reports calculate closing-line value and a registered percentile bootstrap interval.

requirements.requirement: Detect which models are degrading and prevent stale historical performance from preserving production authority indefinitely.

evidence.claim: Versioned model status and report evidence exist, but automated drift alarms over rolling production windows are not yet implemented.

requirements.requirement: Measure calibration and performance by line range, participant role, context, season, league, and market segment.

evidence.claim: Reports include line-range and configured segment breakdowns; production role and season coverage depend on supplied data.

requirements.requirement: Learn which sportsbooks move first and use that history to improve consensus weighting.
requirements.blocker: Minute-level multi-book historical movement data has not been supplied.

evidence.claim: The line-movement schema can consume history, but there is no licensed long-horizon movement corpus in the repository.

requirements.requirement: Measure whether registered features stop improving out-of-sample performance and retire or revise degraded model versions.

evidence.claim: Feature descriptions and immutable model versions are registered, but automated feature-ablation monitoring is not yet implemented.

requirements.requirement: Measure and penalize model overconfidence using calibration error, slope, intercept, and reliability buckets.

evidence.claim: The metric library calculates expected calibration error, calibration slope and intercept, and reliability buckets.

requirements.requirement: Evaluate whether measured advantage erodes as recommendation volume or market participation grows.
requirements.blocker: This requires a sufficiently long production history linking recommendation volume, limits, execution, and closing prices.

evidence.claim: The current product does not claim production predictive superiority without sufficient settled history.

requirements.requirement: Normalize teams, players, markets, sides, and books to stable identities instead of relying on display text alone.

evidence.claim: Canonical records preserve stable event, participant, market-family, side, and sportsbook identity fields.

requirements.requirement: Retain historical opening, intermediate, offered, and closing odds with source timestamps.

evidence.claim: The dataset contract retains offered and closing prices, but a complete historical provider archive is externally blocked.
Settlement records can retain exact sportsbook, capture time, market-close time, finality, source locator, and source digest for a closing line.

requirements.requirement: Match sportsbook observations to the exact event before attaching any market price.

evidence.claim: Candidate pricing requires same-game matching before event-level market matching.

requirements.requirement: Resolve player identity deterministically and retain the provider participant identifier.

evidence.claim: Displayed-target records resolve and preserve participant identifiers separately from names.

requirements.requirement: Retain capture time and source time for every decision-relevant observation.

evidence.claim: Source envelopes require capturedAt and sourceTime fields.

requirements.requirement: Represent corrections as immutable amendments rather than silently rewriting prior decisions.

evidence.claim: Analytics tests reconstruct amended state from append-only records.

requirements.requirement: Fail closed or classify missing data explicitly instead of silently imputing decision authority.

evidence.claim: Dataset and decision validation report missing required fields and block invalid rows.
Legacy, malformed, incomplete, non-binary, and missing-closing-line evidence is explicitly excluded or blocked without inferred values.

requirements.requirement: Retain stable immutable model identifiers, versions, training cutoffs, and calculation policy evidence.

evidence.claim: The model registry stores model identity, version, market family, feature set, training cutoff, and status.

requirements.requirement: Attach immutable settlement outcomes to prior evaluations and reject orphan settlement references.

evidence.claim: API tests prove settlement persistence, final closing-line provenance retention, and orphan-reference rejection.
Projection tests prove immutable settlement amendments are applied in sequence and incomplete closing evidence cannot become a settled calibration outcome.

requirements.requirement: Calculate expected value from probability and exact offered price for every priced decision.

evidence.claim: calculateExpectedValue returns expected profit and return on stake.

requirements.requirement: Evaluate how a decision changes as price changes and expose a strict minimum acceptable price.

evidence.claim: The price boundary solves expected-value and Kelly constraints as functions of odds.

requirements.requirement: Retain sample size and prevent unsupported small samples from receiving production authority.

evidence.claim: Promotion rules require minimum settled counts and bucket support.

requirements.requirement: Apply conservative bankroll fractions, stake caps, minimum stakes, and Kelly multipliers.

evidence.claim: applyStakeCaps enforces bankroll and absolute stake limits.

requirements.requirement: Measure and cap correlated risk rather than summing positions as independent exposures.

evidence.claim: Correlation keys and configured exposure caps are evaluated before a BET can pass.

requirements.requirement: Track drawdown and use registered loss-control policy rather than chasing losses.

evidence.claim: The authoritative settlement and amendment history drives high-water-mark drawdown, loss-streak stake reduction, and hard exposure stops.

requirements.requirement: Combine quantitative modelers, data engineers, sport analysts, market analysts, execution specialists, and risk management rather than relying on one discipline.
requirements.blocker: Human staffing, role separation, and operating procedures cannot be established by repository code alone.

evidence.claim: The attachment defines the required cross-functional operating structure.

requirements.requirement: Size positions conservatively so small estimated edges can survive variance.

evidence.claim: Fractional Kelly and hard bankroll caps reduce model stake recommendations.

requirements.requirement: Diversify exposure across events, participants, market families, and correlation groups within registered caps.

evidence.claim: Portfolio risk retains and caps four distinct exposure dimensions.

requirements.requirement: Never increase risk merely to recover prior losses or override a tilt lock.

evidence.claim: TILT_LOCK is a hard PASS gate.

requirements.requirement: Maintain sufficient capital and liquidity to survive variance without weakening risk policy.
requirements.blocker: Actual capitalization, liquidity, and customer suitability are operator and financial governance responsibilities outside source code.

evidence.claim: The source identifies capital sufficiency as an operating requirement.

requirements.requirement: Judge process over long registered out-of-sample histories rather than short winning or losing streaks.

evidence.claim: Promotion thresholds require large settled samples and cannot be satisfied by a three-win streak.

requirements.requirement: Refresh source, market, candidate, and decision health rapidly enough to avoid presenting known-stale opportunities.

evidence.claim: The auto-update service refreshes provider, game, candidate, and decision-log snapshots.

requirements.requirement: Automatically match event, participant, market family, side, line, and sportsbook before evaluating an offer.

evidence.claim: Best-target pricing performs event and exact outcome matching before serialization.

requirements.requirement: Deliver immediate, unambiguous alerts containing exact line, price, sportsbook, minimum price, timestamp, and expiry.

evidence.claim: The dashboard can display refreshed recommendations, but push notification delivery is not implemented.

requirements.requirement: Make the calculated minimum acceptable price clear and machine-readable in recommendation and audit output.

evidence.claim: API tests require a priceDiscipline object with minimumAcceptableAmericanOdds and validUntil.

requirements.requirement: Provide a usable local and private-LAN delivery path without making remote services mandatory.

evidence.claim: The repository contains the private-LAN launch path for phone access.

requirements.requirement: Automatically withdraw or mark inactive any recommendation whose price, line, source evidence, lineup, injury, or time validity is no longer acceptable.

evidence.claim: Machine-readable invalidation conditions and expiry status exist, but a durable lifecycle worker has not yet withdrawn previously delivered records.

requirements.requirement: Retain independent fair probabilities as a distinct input rather than replacing them with sportsbook consensus.

evidence.claim: Independent modelProbability and fairAmericanOdds are emitted before pricing.

requirements.requirement: Use market consensus as an intelligent prior without pretending the market is infallible.

evidence.claim: Market confidence controls blend weight while independent probability remains present.

requirements.requirement: Timestamp and content-digest every decision so later evidence cannot be inserted retrospectively without detection.

evidence.claim: Ledger tests cover immutable records, digest conflicts, duplicate identifiers, and append behavior.

requirements.requirement: Persist every displayed evaluation in the authoritative append-only ledger before returning it to a user-facing workflow.

evidence.claim: The best-target endpoint returns no recommendation when authoritative persistence fails.

requirements.requirement: Use conservative fractional Kelly and portfolio caps rather than full-Kelly or conviction-based manual sizing.

evidence.claim: Fractional Kelly multipliers and stake caps are part of deterministic policy.

requirements.requirement: Do not place wagers automatically; the product is decision support and requires human execution.
requirements.prohibitionReason: Automatic wagering increases legal, contractual, safety, and user-control risk and is outside the approved product scope.

evidence.claim: Automatic wager placement is an explicit non-goal.

requirements.requirement: Do not conceal betting identities or construct networks intended to evade sportsbook controls.
requirements.prohibitionReason: Identity concealment is legally, ethically, and contractually incompatible with transparent customer software.

evidence.claim: The architecture prohibits bypassing sportsbook terms, access controls, or technical protections.

requirements.requirement: Do not facilitate account sharing or multi-account evasion.
requirements.prohibitionReason: Account sharing may violate law and sportsbook terms and creates identity and consumer-protection risk.

evidence.claim: Access-control and sportsbook-term bypass is excluded from the system.

requirements.requirement: Do not manipulate lines through deceptive wagers, spoofing, or coordinated false signals.
requirements.prohibitionReason: Manipulative execution is unethical, potentially unlawful, and incompatible with auditable decision support.

evidence.claim: The approved system is analytical and does not execute or manipulate markets.

requirements.requirement: Do not acquire, scrape, redistribute, or commercialize data without the required legal rights and licenses.
requirements.prohibitionReason: Unlicensed data acquisition threatens legality, provider relationships, and acquisition diligence.

evidence.claim: The provider plan calls for configured, attributable data sources and keeps unsupported lanes manual-only.

requirements.requirement: Do not solicit, store, or exploit material nonpublic inside information.
requirements.prohibitionReason: Inside information creates legal, ethical, privacy, and integrity risk and is unnecessary for the approved architecture.

evidence.claim: The attachment explicitly lists inside information among tactics Bear Edge must not copy.

requirements.requirement: Do not insert recommendations after outcomes or market movement are known.
requirements.prohibitionReason: Retrospective insertion destroys auditability and creates deceptive performance history.

evidence.claim: Immutable timestamps, identifiers, and content digests provide tamper evidence for appended records.

requirements.requirement: Do not delete losing recommendations or rewrite settlements to improve reported performance.
requirements.prohibitionReason: Deleting losses falsifies model performance and violates the authoritative append-only evidence model.

evidence.claim: The authoritative store appends immutable evaluation, settlement, and amendment records instead of updating history.

requirements.requirement: Do not advertise a win rate, predictive advantage, or profitability claim that lacks sufficient settled out-of-sample evidence.
requirements.prohibitionReason: Unproven performance advertising is misleading and can create regulatory and consumer-protection exposure.

evidence.claim: Readiness language separates local functionality from unproven predictive performance.

requirements.requirement: Do not convert every model-market discrepancy into a bet; all evidence, calibration, price, and risk gates must still pass.
requirements.prohibitionReason: A discrepancy can result from noise, stale data, mismatch, high hold, or uncertainty and therefore is not sufficient evidence by itself.

evidence.claim: The evaluation path retains numerous independent PASS and WAIT gates after discrepancy calculation.

requirements.requirement: Do not optimize or promote a model solely because historical return on investment is positive.
requirements.prohibitionReason: Historical return alone is vulnerable to leakage, overfitting, price assumptions, and unstable small samples.

evidence.claim: Promotion requires calibration, proper scoring, sample, coverage, closing-line, and data-integrity evidence rather than ROI alone.

requirements.requirement: Structure the product as a market consensus engine, an independent probability engine, and a decision and risk engine with explicit contracts between them.

evidence.claim: The operating document maps the three source engines to concrete modules and external gates.

requirements.requirement: Observe multiple books, remove vig, identify informative books, calculate consensus, and detect stale or outlying offers.

evidence.claim: All engine components exist locally except historically learned book-quality weights and a production movement corpus.

requirements.requirement: Use sport-specific data to model player or team performance and relevant lineup, matchup, rest, pace, weather, injury, and role context while outputting uncertainty.

evidence.claim: Sport-specific estimators and official context exist, but the full contextual feature set and per-prediction uncertainty require additional licensed data and model work.

requirements.requirement: Compare model and market, apply calibration and shrinkage, calculate edge and expected value, inspect data quality, enforce risk, issue PASS WAIT or BET, publish a minimum price, and lock the timestamped record.

evidence.claim: Displayed recommendations retain gates and are appended to the immutable ledger before API return.

requirements.requirement: Allow one outlier sportsbook offer to qualify while rejecting consensus-priced offers on the same selection when only the outlier clears the minimum price.

evidence.claim: Best-price selection and minimum-price tests demonstrate that the sportsbook price, not selection identity alone, controls qualification.

requirements.requirement: Reduce an historically overconfident raw model estimate before comparing the adjusted probability with the outlier offer.

evidence.claim: Calibration authority and reports are enforced, but current research models have not accumulated real evidence for a production recalibration transform.

requirements.requirement: Answer the true probability as a calibrated range or uncertainty-aware estimate rather than a falsely exact point.

evidence.claim: Candidate output includes point, lower, and upper probabilities, interval width, observed evidence, approximation method, and limitations.

requirements.requirement: Answer what raw and no-vig probability the exact available market price is charging.

evidence.claim: The offered market record contains implied probability, no-vig probability, hold, and timestamp status.

requirements.requirement: Determine whether the difference is supported by verified evidence, tradable at the exact book, and large enough after uncertainty and risk constraints.

evidence.claim: The decision path combines verified price, calibration, minimum price, expected value, and portfolio gates.

requirements.requirement: Identify the best fresh offer and explicit expiration quickly enough that a user can determine whether the price still exists.

evidence.claim: Best fresh price and expiration are computed, but post-delivery sportsbook availability cannot be guaranteed.

requirements.requirement: Reject a directionally strong prediction when the available price eliminates expected value.

evidence.claim: The minimum-price boundary rejects a price that cannot satisfy expected-value and Kelly requirements.

requirements.requirement: Permit market-consensus mispricing logic to identify value without claiming the independent model predicts every event better than the market.

evidence.claim: Consensus and outlier analysis are distinct from independent model direction.

requirements.requirement: Treat detection latency and price freshness as part of edge rather than as presentation metadata.

evidence.claim: Timestamp freshness directly changes confidence, risk flags, and verdict eligibility.

requirements.requirement: Preserve enough immutable evidence to prove each edge, decision, price, model version, and outcome afterward.

evidence.claim: Canonical immutable records retain source, model, probability, price, edge, stake, gate, and audit evidence.

requirements.requirement: Retain the source references supporting the operating thesis without treating private-system anecdotes as audited proof of future Bear Edge performance.

evidence.claim: The exact source document and its SHA-256 digest are retained in this requirement ledger.
